QuestInfo.name: Gere's Prized Pupil
QuestInfo.0: #rProfession Grand Opening Quest\n#k(Available until Jan 31st, 2011)#k\nYou're a Lv #r10#k Blacksmith already? Go see Master #bGere#k.
QuestInfo.1: What kind of gift could #bGere#k have for you?
QuestInfo.2: Are you a #bMaster of Smithing#k now?

0.0: Lv. 10 Blacksmith? You, #h0#? I...did not expect that. I suppose you want a gift, then?

yes.0: Very well. I'm in no position to argue. Speak with me again in a moment.

no.0: At least you have humility. If you change your mind, I have something I MIGHT be able to spare until #rJanuary 31, 2011#k...

1.0: This is an #rAndroid#k Recipe. Only master Blacksmiths can craft an Android this advanced. \nI have difficulty believing it, but you might be able to craft it yourself.
